title: Windows Hello for Business is not configured or does not require a TPM

messages.businessImpact: Sign-in stays dependent on passwords, which are phishable and reusable, or the credential is protected only by software so it can be copied off the device.
remediation: Enable Windows Hello for Business in the enrolment settings.
Require a Trusted Platform Module so the credential is bound to the hardware.
messages.cannotSee: Whether Windows Hello suits an organisation is a decision rather than a fault: a tenant using another factor deliberately will be reported here. Only the tenant-wide policy is read, so a Windows Hello setting delivered through a configuration profile instead is invisible to this rule.
